title: Technology Sector Update for 07/30/2018: LOGM,MSFT,PRKR,ON,CYOU

Technology stocks got rocked again to begin the new week, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 index Monday falling almost 1.5% while the Philadelphia Semiconductor index was sliding nearly 0.8% lower in late trading.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ LogMeIn ( LOGM ) climbed as much as 4% on Monday after the password management company announced a new integration for its LastPass log-in tool allowing employees at companies using Microsoft's ( MSFT ) active directory federation services to also access LastPass using their Active Directory credentials. Currently, the LastPass integration with Active Direction is only available for new customers, although LogMeIn is expecting the integration will be available for existing users and already-provisioned users later this year.
In other sector news:
+ ParkerVision ( PRKR ) climbed over 4% on Monday after the radio-frequency technology company announced a $2 million securities purchase agreement with Aspire Capital Fund LLC. Under terms of the agreement, the company will receive $975,000 upfront and is slated to receive the balance after a registration statement for the transaction is declared effective by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
- ON Semiconductor ( ON ) was trading near its session low Monday afternoon, dropping almost 7%, despite reporting Q2 net income and revenue topping analyst estimates. The semiconductor components manufacturer also sees Q3 sales in-line to above Street view.
- Changyou.com ( CYOU ) dropped to an all-time low on Monday, sinking over 15% to a worst-ever $12.68 a share after the mobile gaming platform reported Q2 revenue missing the Capital IQ consensus and upstaging better-than-expected net income for the April-to-June reporting period. It also guided Q3 sales lagging the Street view.
